name: browse-and-filter
description: Drives the real MainActivity: feed -> cart -> back to feed -> open the filter sheet. Jetsnack's content is entirely hardcoded (SnackRepo / SearchRepo), so the app cold-starts fully populated and every step has a real click target — unlike a network-backed sample, the tour is genuinely renderable. It captures the two animations that define Jetsnack and that no @Preview can reach, because both are driven by click state rather than by a parameter: the bottom bar's animated selection indicator sliding between destinations, and the shared-element transition that grows the filter icon into the full filter sheet. The runs of numbered 'transition' steps are not filler — the renderer advances the animation clock roughly one step per tour step, and Jetsnack's navigation uses low-stiffness springs (spatialExpressiveSpring), so a destination change needs about eight steps to settle. Those steps therefore capture the spring frame by frame, and the last of each run is the settled screen.
